senses.gloss:
प्रब(व)र्ह a. Most excellent, best; धृष्टद्युम्नः सोमकानां
 प्रबर्हः Mb. 1. 193. 1.
प्रब(व)ह्लिका See प्रहेलिका.

प्रवह्लिः, -ह्ली (also -ह्लिका and -ह्लीका)
 See प्रहेलिका. A riddle, enigma; विदग्धबालेङ्गितगुप्तिचातुरीप्रवह्लिकोत्पाटनपाटवे हृदः N. 16. 102.

प्रवह्लिः, -ह्ली (also -ह्लिका and -ह्लीका)
 See प्रहेलिका. A riddle, enigma; विदग्धबालेङ्गितगुप्तिचातुरीप्रवह्लिकोत्पाटनपाटवे हृदः N. 16. 102.

प्रबा(वा)लः, -लम्
—1 A sprout, shoot, new leaf; अपि … … प्रवालमासामनुबन्धि वीरुधाम्
 Ku. 5. 34, 1. 44, 3. 8; R. 6. 12, 13. 49.
—2 Coral; शुद्धं दृढं घनं वृत्तं स्निग्धं पात्रसुरङ्गकम् । समं
 गुरु सिराहीनं प्रबालं धारयेच्छुभम् ॥ Rājanighaṇṭu.
—3 The neck of the Indian lute.

प्रवच् €2 P.
—1 To speak, say, address.
—2 To tell, relate, announce.
—3 To explain.
—4 To recite.
—5 To celebrate.

प्रवाच् a.
—1 Eloquent, oratorical; (कुर्वते) जडानप्यनुलोमार्थान् प्रवाचः
 कृतिनां गिरः Śi. 2. 25.
—2 Talkative, garrulous; प्रवाचः कार्पण्यात् Mu. 3. 16.
प्रवक्तव्य a. To be announced, taught, explained.

प्रवक्तृ m.
—1 One who declares or relates, a speaker, declarer.
—2 A teacher, expounder; धर्मप्रवक्ता नृपतेर्न तु शूद्रः कथंचन
 Ms. 8. 20; Pt. 3. 73.
—3 An orator, eloquent man.

—1 Speaking, declaration, announcement; प्रवचने मान्द्यम् Pt. 1. 190.
—2 Teaching, expounding.
—3 Exposition, explanation, interpretation; नायमात्मा प्रवचनेन लभ्यो
 न भेधया न बहुना श्रुतेन Kaṭh. 1. 2. 22; लब्ध्वा ज्ञानमनेकधा
 प्रवचनैर्मन्वादयः प्राणयन् Mv. 4. 25; Bhāg. 7. 15. 1.
—4 Eloquence.
—5 A sacred treatise or writing; Ms. 3. 184.
—6 An expression, a term.
—7 A system of doctrines (in the form of a treatise).
—8 The fundamental doctrine of the Buddhists.

—1 Proclamation, promulgation, declaration.
—2 A designation.

प्रवचनम् + .{@-नः@} One who exposes, propounds; Bhāg. 10. 87. 11.
.━{@Comp.@}: प्रवचनपटु
प्रवचनम् + -पटु a. skilled in talking, eloquent.

प्रवचनीय a.
—1 To be taught, propounded.
—2 To be well spoken.

प्रवचनीय + .{@-यः@}
—1 A propounder, teacher. —2 An orator, speaker.

प्रवगः, प्रवङ्गः, प्रवङ्गमः A monkey; see प्लवग,
 प्लवङ्ग, प्लवङ्गम.

प्रवगः, प्रवङ्गः, प्रवङ्गमः A monkey; see प्लवग,
 प्लवङ्ग, प्लवङ्गम.

प्रवगः, प्रवङ्गः, प्रवङ्गमः A monkey; see प्लवग,
 प्लवङ्ग, प्लवङ्गम.
प्रवटः Wheat.
प्रावटः Barley.

प्रवण a. Sloping down, inclined, shelving, flowing downwards;
 प्रागुदक्प्रबणां वेदिं विशालां दीप्तपावकाम् (ददर्श) Rām. 2. 99. 24.
—2 Steep, abrupt, precipitous.
—3 Crooked, bent.
—4 Inclined, disposed to, tending to (oft. at the end of comp.); भयेकप्रवणः
 Ki. 3. 19; श्वपचप्रवणो भवेत् Mb. 13. 136. 18.
—5 Devoted or attached to, addicted to, intent on, prone to, full of;
 नृभिः प्राणत्राणप्रवणमतिभिः कैश्चिदधुना Bh. 3. 29; Śi. 8. 35;
 Mu. 5. 21; Ki. 2. 44.
—6 Favourably inclined or disposed towards; Ku. 4. 42.
—7 Eager, ready; प्रवणोऽस्मि वरं दातुम् Mb. 15. 29. 22. फलसंपत्प्रवणः Ki. 2. 8.
—8 Endowed with, possessed of.
—9 Humbled, modestly humble, submissive.
—10 Decayed, wasted, waning.
—11 Generous.

प्रवण + .{@-णः@}
—1 A place where four roads meet.
—2 A moment.
—3 A whirlpool.

प्रवण + .{@-णम्@}
—1 A descent, a steep descent, precipice; उदके भूरियं धार्या मर्तव्यं
 प्रवणे मया Mb. 5. 136. 13.
—2 The side of a hill, slope, declivity.
—3 The belly.
—4 An access to.
प्रवाणम् The trimming or edging of a piece of woven cloth.
प्रावणम् A spade, hoe, shovel.

—1 Slope, inclination, declivity.
—2 Propensity, tendency.
प्रवणायति Den. P. To feel inclined or disposed.
प्रवणायितम् Inclination, propensity, bias.

प्रवणीकृ €8 U. To incline favourably towards, overcome, win over;
 तपसा तत्प्रवणीकृतो हरः Ku. 4. 42.

प्रवत् f. Ved.
—1 A precipice, declivity.
—2 Height, elevation.
—3 A sloping path, easy passage; यथाप; प्रवतायन्ति T. Up. 1. 4. 3.

प्रवत्स्यत् a. (-ती, -न्ती f.)
 About to go on a journey.
.━{@Comp.@}: प्रवत्स्यत्पतिका

प्रवत्स्यत् + -पतिका the wife of one who intends to go on a journey (one of
 the 8 Nāyikās in erotic poetry); यस्याः पतिरग्रिमक्षणे देशान्तरं
 यास्यत्येव सा प्रवत्स्यत्पतिका Ras. M.

प्रवद् €1 P.
—1 To say, speak, utter.
—2 To speak to, address; सुग्रीवः प्रावदन् नृपम् Bk. 7. 24.
—3 To name, call.
—4 To regard, consider.
—5 To converse or talk with.
—6 To proclaim, declare. ━Caus.
—1 To cause to speak.
—2 To play on (a musical instrument).
प्रवदनम् Ved. A proclamation, announcement.

—1 Uttering a word or sound.
—2 Expressing, mentioning, declaring.
—3 Discourse, conversation.
—4 Talk, report, rumour, popular saying or belief; अनुरागप्रवादस्तु
 वत्सयोः सार्वलौकिकः Māl. 1. 13; व्याध्रो मानुषं खादतीति लोकप्रवादो
 दुर्निवारः H. 1; Ratn. 4. 15.
—5 A fable or myth.
—6 Litigious language.
—7 Words of challenge, mutual defiance; इत्थं प्रवादं युधि संप्रहारं
 प्रचक्रतू रामनिशाविहारौ Bk. 2. 36.
—8 A base or crude form (Ved.); (in gram.) any form or case.
—9 Ill-rumour, slander, calumny; अवापुरारभ्य ततश्चला इति प्रवादमुच्चैरयशस्करं
 श्रियः Śi. 1. 44.
—10 Pretext, excuse; शत्रुः पतिप्रवादेन … बाले परिधृतस्त्वया
 Rām. 2. 7. 27.
प्रवादक a. Playing on (a musical instrument).

प्रवादिन् a.
—1 Uttering a sound; speaking, reporting.
—2 Being in some grammatical form or case.

प्रवप् €1 U.
—1 To throw, cast, offer; प्रबपाणि शिरौ भूमौ वानरस्य वनाच्छिदः Bk. 9. 98.
—2 To scatter, strew.

प्रवप a.
—1 Very fat.
—2 Having a thick membrane or omentum; P. VIII. 4. 16 com.

प्रवपणम् Ved.
—1 Scattering forth.
—2 Shaving or shearing off.
प्रवापिन् a. Scattering, sowing; तथैवाक्षेत्रिणो बीजं परक्षेत्रप्रवापिणः Ms. 9. 51.

—1 The upper part of a piece of woven cloth.
—2 A goad, a whip; स्वयमादित प्रवयणं प्रजापतिः Śi. 13. 19.

प्रवयस् a.
—1 Advanced in age, aged, old; केप्येते प्रवयसस्त्वां दिदृक्षवः U. 4; R. 8. 18.
—2 Ancient, old.
—3 Strong, vigorous (Ved.).

प्रवर a.
—1 Chief, principal, most excellent or distinguished, best, exalted; भीष्मः
 कुरूणां प्रवरः Mb. 3. 85. 116; संकेतके चिरयति प्रबरो विनोदः
 Mk. 3. 3; Ms. 10. 27; Ghaṭ. 16.
—2 Eldest.
प्रवर + .{@-रा@} N. of a river falling into the Godāvarī.

प्रवर + .{@-रः@} A call, summons.
—2 A particular invocation addressed to Agni by a Brāhmaṇa at the consecration of his fire.
—3 A line of ancestors.
—4 A race, family, lineage.
—5 An ancestor.
—6 A Muni or noble ancestor who contributes to the
[]
 credit of a particular gotra or family; said to be the friend of Indra;
 पुरश्चकार प्रवरं वरं यमायन् सखायं ददर्श तया सः N. 14. 62;
 cf. पञ्च˚, त्रि˚.
—7 Offspring, descendants.
—8 A cover, covering.
—9 An upper garment.
—10 One of the 42 Gotras.
प्रवारः, प्रवारकः A cover, covering.

—1 A fence, an enclosure.
—2 An upper garment (according to Hemacandra).
—3 N. of a country.

—1 An upper garment, a cloak, mantle; (‘द्वौ प्रावारोत्तरासङ्गौ समौ बृहतिका तथा’);
 ययुर्विन्ध्यं शरन्मेघैः प्रावारैः
[]
 प्रवरैरिव Bk. 7. 53; Mb. 1. 1. 133; also प्रावारक; Mk. 8. 22.
—2 N. of a district.
.━{@Comp.@}: प्रावारकीटः

प्रवर + .{@-रम्@}
—1 Aloe-wood
—2 A particular high number; Buddh.
.━{@Comp.@}: प्रवरकल्याण, प्रवरजनः, प्रवरधातुः, प्रवरललितम्, प्रवरवाहनौ
प्रवर + -कल्याण a. eminently beautiful.
प्रवर + -जनः a person of quality.
प्रवर + -धातुः precious metal.

प्रवर + -ललितम् N. of a metre with each line of sixteen syllables; V. Ratn.
 See appendix.
प्रवर + -वाहनौ (du.) an epithet of the two Aśvins.

—1 Call, summons &c.
—2 (With Buddhists) Festivities at the end of the rainy season.

—1 Satisfying (a desire).
—2 Priority of choice.
—3 Prohibition, opposition.
—4 A free-will offering (काम्यदान).
प्रावरणम् A garment, covering; especially an upper garment, cloak, mantle.

—1 The sacrificial fire.
—2 An epithet of Viṣṇu.

प्रवर्ग्यः A ceremony preliminary to the Soma sacrifice; प्रबग्र्यं
 शास्त्रतः कृत्वा Rām. 1. 14. 4; Bhāg. 3. 13. 37.
प्रवर्जनम् The performance of the प्रवर्ग्य ceremony.

प्रवलाकिन् m.
—1 A peacock.
—2 A snake.
प्रवल्ग् €1 P., Ā. To move the limbs quickly, bound, leap.

प्रवस् €1 P.
—1 To live, dwell.
—2 To go abroad, sojourn, be absent from home, travel; विधाय वृत्तिं
 भार्यायाः प्रवसेत् कार्यवान्नरः Ms. 9. 74; R. 11. 4. ━Caus.
 To banish, send into exile; एकस्थमथ संरुध्यात् पुत्रवान् वा प्रवासयेत् Kau. A. 1. 15.

—1 Going or journeying abroad, going on a journey.
—2 Dying disease.

—1 Living abroad, temporary sojourn.
—2 Exile, banishment; सीताविवासनपटोः करुणा कुतस्ते U. 2. 10.
—3 Killing, slaughter.
—4 Going from a town.

—1
——(a) Going or journeying abroad, being absent from oneʼs home, foreign
 residence; कुशः प्रवासस्थकलत्रवेषाम् (वनितामपश्यत्) R. 16. 4;
 Ś. 4. 3; U. 6. 38; स्नेहः प्रवासाश्रयात् Pt. 1. 169; Bh. 3. 94.
——(b) A temporary sojourn; प्रवासादुपावृत्तेन काश्यपेनादिष्टोऽस्मि Ś. 4.
—2 (In astr.) Heliacal setting of the planets.
.━{@Comp.@}: प्रवासगत, प्रवासस्थ, प्रवासस्थित, प्रवासपर
प्रवासः + -गत, -स्थ, -स्थित a. journeying abroad, being absent from home.
प्रवासः + -गत, -स्थ, -स्थित a. journeying abroad, being absent from home.
प्रवासः + -गत, -स्थ, -स्थित a. journeying abroad, being absent from home.
प्रवासः + -पर a. addicted to living abroad.
प्रवासित a. Banished, exiled.

प्रवासिन् m. A traveller, wayfarer, sojourner; परलोकनवप्रवासिनः
 प्रतिपत्स्ये पदवीमहं तव Ku. 4. 10.
प्रवास्य a. To be sent abroad, banished; Ms. 8. 284.

प्रवह् €1 P.
—1 To bear, carry, draw along.
—2 To waft, carry or bear along; प्रवहन्तं सदामोदम् Bk. 8. 52.
—3 To support, bear up (as a burden).
—4 To flow, stream forth.
—5 To blow.
—6 To have, possess, feel.
—7 To breathe.
—8 To exhibit, show.

—1 Flowing or streaming forth.
—2 Wind.
—3 N. of one of the seven courses of wind (said to cause the motion of
 the planets); प्राणापानौ समानं च व्यानोदानौ च तत्त्वतः । अधश्चैवानिलं
 ज्ञात्वा प्रवहं चानिलं पुनः ॥ सप्त वातांस्तथा ज्ञात्वा Mb. 12. 301. 27-28;
 एकः पिपासुः प्रवहानिलस्य N. 22. 77.
—4 A reservoir into which water is carried off.
—5 Going forth, going from a town.

—1 Flowing or streaming forth.
—2 A stream, course, current; प्रवाहस्ते वारां श्रियमयमपारां दिशतु
 नः G. L. 2; R. 5. 46, 13. 10, 48; Ku. 1. 54; Me. 48.
—3 Flow, running water.
—4 Continuous flow, unbroken succession, continuity.
—5 Course of events (rolling onward like a stream).
—6 Activity, active occupation.
—7 A pond, lake.
—8 Course or direction towards.
—9 An excellent horse. (प्रवाहेमूत्रितम् means (lit.) making water
 in a stream; (fig.) doing a useless action).

—1 A covered carriage or litter (for women); आरुह प्रवहणम् Mk. 4. 23/24.
—2 A carriage, conveyance, vehicle in general.
—3 A ship; प्रवहणनिमित्तमेकोऽमात्यः सर्वानमात्यानावाहयेत् Kau. A. 1. 10.
प्रवहणी, -निकायः Corporation of workmen; Kau. A. 2. 4.
प्रवाहणी The sphincter muscle which ejects the faeces from the rectum.
प्रवहणी, -निकायः Corporation of workmen; Kau. A. 2. 4.
प्रवाहक a. Carrying off or forward.
प्रवाहक + .{@-कः@} A goblin, an imp.

—1 Driving forth.
—2 Evacuation by stool.
प्रवाहिका Diarrhoea.

प्रवाहिन् a.
—1 Carrying forward, driving onward.
—2 Carrying away.
—3 Flowing, streaming forth.
प्रवाही Sand.

प्रवह्लिः, -ह्ली (also -ह्लिका and -ह्लीका)
 See प्रहेलिका. A riddle, enigma; विदग्धबालेङ्गितगुप्तिचातुरीप्रवह्लिकोत्पाटनपाटवे हृदः N. 16. 102.

प्रवह्लिः, -ह्ली (also -ह्लिका and -ह्लीका)
 See प्रहेलिका. A riddle, enigma; विदग्धबालेङ्गितगुप्तिचातुरीप्रवह्लिकोत्पाटनपाटवे हृदः N. 16. 102.
प्रवाकः A proclaimer.

प्रवाचक a.
—1 Explanatory.
—2 Eloquent.
प्रवाच्यम् A literary production or composition.

प्रवाणिः, -णी f.
 A weaverʼs shuttle.

प्रवाणिः, -णी f.
 A weaverʼs shuttle.
प्रवात p. p. Exposed to stormy wind.

प्रवात + .{@-तम्@}
—1 A current of air, fresh or free air; प्रवातशयनस्था देवी M. 4.
[]
—2 A strong or stormy wind; ननु प्रवातेऽपि निष्कम्पा गिरयः Ś. 6.
—3 An airy place; प्रवातनीलोत्पलनिर्विशेषम् Ku. 1. 46.
.━{@Comp.@}: प्रवातशयनम्, प्रवातसुभग
प्रवात + -शयनम् a bed placed in the airy place.
प्रवात + -सुभग a. delightful by a fresh breeze.
प्रवारः, प्रवारकः A cover, covering.

प्रावारकः An upper garment, mantle; यदीच्छसि लम्बदशाविशालं
 प्रावारकं सूत्रशतैर्हि युक्तम् Mk. 8. 22; जातीकुसुमवासितः प्रावारकोऽनुप्रेषितः Mk. 1.
प्रवाल See प्रबाल.

प्रविकीर्ण p. p.
—1 Scattered or strewed about.
—2 Dispersed, diffused.
.━{@Comp.@}: प्रविकीर्णकामा
प्रविकीर्ण + -कामा a woman who has various lovers.

प्रविख्यात p. p.
—1 Named, called.
—2 Famous, renowned, celebrated.
प्रविख्यातिः f. Fame, renown, celebrity.

प्रविघटित p. p. Hewn off, severed; झटिति विततवह्नपुद्गारभास्वत्कुठारप्रविघटितकठोरस्कन्धबन्धः
 कबन्धः Mv. 2. 59.
प्रविचयः Examination, investigation.

प्रविचर् €1 P.
—1 To roam about.
—2 To move onward, advance.
—3 To wander through.
प्रविचरः Discernment, discrimination.

प्रविचारः Distinction, division, species, kind.
.━{@Comp.@}: प्रविचारमार्गः

प्रविचारः + -मार्गः (pl.) springing from side to side (an artifice in fighting);
 चचार चित्रं प्रविचारमार्गैः Ki. 17. 56.
प्रविचारित p. p. Examined, investigated accurately.

प्रविचल् €1 P.
—1 To shake, tremble.
—2 To deviate, swerve from, go astray; न्याग्यात् पथः प्रविचलन्ति पदं
 न धीराः Bh. 2. 83.
—3 To become confused.
प्रविचलित a. Moved, set in motion, shaken.
प्रविचित a. Tried, proved.
प्रविचेतनम् Understanding.

प्रवितत p. p.
—1 Spread out, expanded.
—2 Dishevelled, disordered (hair).
प्रविदारः Bursting asunder, opening.

—1 Tearing, rending, breaking, bursting asunder.
—2 Budding.
—3 Conflict, war, battle.
—4 Crowd, confusion, tumult.
प्रविद्ध p. p. Cast away, thrown off.
प्रविद्रुत p. p. Dispersed, put to flight, scattered.

प्रविधा €3 U.
—1 To decide.
—2 To do or make.
—3 To meditate, think upon.
—4 To place in front or at the head.

—1 Thinking upon.
—2 Doing.
—3 A means employed.

प्रविध्वस्त a.
—1 Thrown away.
—2 Agitated, disturbed.

प्रविपलः, -लम्
 A small part of a Vipala q. v.

प्रविपलः, -लम्
 A small part of a Vipala q. v.

प्रविभज् €1 P.
—1 To sever, separate.
—2 To divide, distribute.

प्रविभक्त p. p.
—1 Severed, separated.

प्रावर्तिक a. (The कम or order) which is followed in the
 first round (i. e. while performing the first of a series of acts
 to be done with reference to several persons or things). Hence ˚कमन्यायः
 is the rule according to which when a series of acts are to be performed
 with reference to several persons or things, the first act may be performed
 in any order one likes, but the subsequent acts are to be performed in
 the very order in which the first act is performed. This is discussed
 and established by जैमिनि and शबर in MS. 5. 1. 8-12. For, thus
 it is that a uniform अङ्गप्रधानप्रत्यासत्ति is achieved.
